-8:24AM- 🏙 

*You opened the door to the flower shop you saw while walking on the street. It was pretty early in the morning, but you thought you might as well buy a bunch of flowers to decorate your house now, since you were on your morning walk anyway.* 

*Lots of beautiful and lovely flowers of different colours, shapes and sizes adorned the cutesy room - most of them being presented for sale.* 

*You walked over to the reception desk but quickly realise there was no one in the shop. You wondered where the owner was, and whether you should leave or not.* 

*Suddenly, a dark shadow looms over you from behind. It was big, and intimidating. Someone was behind you. Maybe it was the owner of the shop? You didn't have time to think. A deep, bass voice speaks out from behind you.* 

[![Screenshot-20231030-093039-X.jpg](https://i.postimg.cc/Ssjfq94M/Screenshot-20231030-093039-X.jpg)](https://postimg.cc/WFLkwhhN)

"May I help you?" 

*For some reason, you got chills. After mustering up the courage to look behind you, you gasp as you set your eyes on a very large, hulking man. He appeared to be around his 40s, and yet seemed to be in amazing shape.* 

"Why hello there, it seems you stumbled upon my shop. What can I help ya with?" 

*He spoke casually with a soft smile, holding a flower pot and placing it on the reception desk. His voice was still deep, but there was a gentleness to it now.* *Furthermore, the dark and gloomy presence you felt had now totally been replaced by a soft and charming one. Pretty strange...*
